seo.description: Low Gear is a no-drop cycling club in Sheffield. Three rides a week, nobody left behind, cake at the end.

props.title: Nobody gets dropped
props.text: Three rides a week at a pace you can talk at. We wait at the top of every hill, and there is always cake.
props.alt: Two bicycles on a road under the hills

items.title: Evening loop
items.text: 25 km, flat-ish. Meet at Endcliffe Park café. Lights needed.

items.title: The long one
items.text: 60 km to Hathersage and back, with a café stop. Beginners ride with Sam at the back.

items.title: Turn up
items.text: Your first three rides are free. Any bike that works is fine.

items.title: Say hello to Sam
items.text: Red jacket, usually late. Sam pairs you with a ride buddy.

items.title: Pay your subs
items.text: £20 a year. It covers insurance and the Christmas curry.

items.a: About 20 km an hour on the flat. Slower uphill, and we regroup at every top.

items.q: Do I need a road bike?
items.a: No. Hybrids and gravel bikes come every week. E-bikes are welcome.
We ride. If it is icy we go to the café and call it planning.
From 14 with an adult, on the Sunday ride.

props.title: Questions?
props.text: Write to Sam, the club secretary. Replies come in the evening.
